Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
Name: Gratis
Description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Changelog: Settings profiles: save up to five, share as text, revert to defaults. First-install Quick setup (look, marker icons, behaviours). Aetheryte and aethernet clicks open the travel card. Quest highlight hides other icons for two seconds; completed quests are green. Location card, tooltips and zone list fixes. Vanilla+ defaults. FATE progress still to come.
